description.zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: Application ID. You can create and query it in the console. Only a single ID is supported.

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于 RTC 3.0 的应用创建推流模板。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used to create a stream ingest template for RTC 3.0 applications.  
### QPS Limit  
The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 10 per user. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
